title: Transforming a Traditional Insurance Giant into a Customer Centric Digital Powerhouse
summary: As part of a major digital transformation, we helped reimagine a legacy insurance ecosystem uniting experiences across customers, employees, and intermediaries, and tackling the complex challenges that come with large-scale change.
imageAlt: Illustrative journey map with lanes for customer, employee, intermediary and system
context: The initiative aimed to establish a unified digital experience across a complex ecosystem spanning customers, employees, and intermediaries.

challenge.lead: Modernise legacy systems. Align fragmented teams. Reimagine the experience from the ground up.
challenge.body: A unified digital experience across a complex ecosystem spanning customers, employees, and intermediaries — with the challenges that come with large-scale change.

approach.title: Discovery first
approach.text: To ensure every sprint was rooted in purpose, each phase kicked off with a focused 1–2 week discovery cycle.

approach.title: Listen to the process
approach.text: Interviews and observational research with stakeholders in the Risk Insurance onboarding process, to understand roles, workflows, pain points and aspirations.

approach.title: Map the whole journey
approach.text: The entire end-to-end business process and customer journey, connecting every touchpoint, decision, and emotion along the way.

built: After months of collaboration, iteration, and testing, we delivered a final design that not only met user expectations but elevated them.

result.headline: A final design that met user expectations — and elevated them.
result.note: No quantified results have been published for this engagement, so none are shown here.

takeaways: Discovery cycles keep every sprint rooted in purpose.
One journey map connects customers, employees and intermediaries.
Large-scale change is a design problem as much as a technology one.
